notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Map cosmetics changed and optimized for more fps.

- Turkish Language added as an Interface option.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Main Menu changed and optimized. Low fps problem fixed.

- Power Attack Damage reduced to 1.5 from 2. Ulti Damage reduced to 2 from 3.

- Stat point gained on kill reduced to 1 from 2.

notes.title: Stat System Update!
notes.content: - Added a new stat system that players can increase their stat points based on their kills. Players can improve their Health, Armor and Damage inside match.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Ulti combo point was unstable on client side fixed.

- Orb collect sound was not available on client side fixed.

- Power attack damage changed from 1.5 to 2.

- Ulti damage changed from 2 to 3.

- Added new orbs to collect on the side of map that gives Health, Armor and Damage.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Key Binding Added.

- Rank system improved and fixed minor bugs.

- Steam Avatar removed from scoreboard.

notes.title: Playtest Bug Fix
notes.content:
- Pass through wall fixed caused by level design.

- UI changed.

- Rank system improved and fixed minor bugs.
